Description:As a Software Engineering Intern at Lockheed Martin, you will join one of the largest networks of software professionals, implementing cutting edge technologies on both existing and new development products. You will be helping us solve the world’s most difficult challenges, developing industry leading technology and products in the areas such as: EO/IR Targeting and Surveillance Systems, Advanced Threat Warning Systems, Combat and Defense Missile development.

You will be involved in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle; design, code, test, integration, verification and field integration support, facilitated by an Agile software development work flow. You will have the opportunity to utilize your skills in many different technical areas including: object oriented software development, real-time embedded development for multi-core and multi-processor systems, development for multiple operating systems (VxWorks, Linux, Windows), defensive cyber security/product protections, image/signal processing, image/inertial tracking, servo/mechanism controls, machine learning, image/data fusion, mission planning and field maintenance application development, other GUI development to support test and verification.
Basic Qualifications:
• Pursing a Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Math, or related major.

• Proficient in C/C++ Software development

• Ability to obtain DoD Clearance

• Must be US Citizen
Desired Skills:
• Familiarity and understanding of differences between relevant C++ standards (ie. C++98; C++11; C++17, etc)

• Experience with Software integration and debugging techniques. Experience with Object Oriented design and associated documentation.

• Detailed understanding of Operating System concepts/features/differences (Linux, VxWorks, Windows).

• Experience with Software Continuous Integration (CI) toolchains/pipelines (configuration management, automated unit testing, static analysis, etc).

• Experience with GUI development utilizing C++/Qt framework or C#

• Experience with Git or similar software configuration management tool
Security Clearance Statement: This position requires a government security clearance, you must be a US Citizen for consideration.
Clearance Level: Secret

Schedules range from standard 40 hours over a five day work week while others may be condensed. These condensed schedules provide employees with additional time away from the office and are in addition to our Paid Time off benefits.

Job Description BAE Systems is seeking a talented, motivated Computer/Software Engineering internship candidate who wants to join a team at a dynamic company that values your technical excellence. At our Space Systems facility in Manassas, VA we develop and produce a wide array of space products, from single-board radiation hardened computers to complete space payloads, for commercial, military, and space communities. The company specializes in radiation-hardened electronics and space applications, including application-specific integrated circuits, memories, and single-board computers. Our single-board computer products are flying on over 250 different spacecraft, including three generations of Mars rovers and Advanced Extremely High Frequency (AEHF) communication satellites.

The Software Engineering organization is responsible for the analysis, specification, planning, development, design, integration, testing, and production of embedded software and test solutions for our prime mission equipment. We support the definition of SW/test architectures and designs that achieve "best value" goals for meeting performance and life cycle requirements within allocated budget and schedule constraints, while maintaining consistency with established company practices and methods. The organization supports concurrent engineering with specialty disciplines to define software and test requirements, designs, and products. As a software intern, you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects, collaborating with our experienced engineers to design, develop, and deploy software solutions. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software development, learn from industry experts, and contribute to the development of cutting-edge technology.

We offer a supportive environment that allows you to continue to learn via training and mentoring, and advance your technical skills through performing assigned responsibilities which may include:
• Developing embedded software for Board Support Packages (BSP) and Start-up ROM (SUROM)
• Developing automated test software in a variety of languages
• Supporting technical work in areas ranging from the design, verification, test of space products and systems
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements
• Participating in integration activities of production test systems
• Participating in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of the codebase
• Generating, reviewing and updating the technical content of drawings, engineering specifications, reports, and other documents associated with the engineering process
• Troubleshooting and debugging software or test-related issues

Cross Department work sharing may lead to performing work in system or processor design and simulation, lab test and debug, or software engineering activities related to operational and test software.Required Education, Experience, & Skills • Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's Degree program in Computer, Software or Electrical Engineering
• Proficiency with programming in C/C++
• Interest in embedded processors (Raspberry-Pi, Arduino, etc.)
• Interest is operating systems
• Ability to perform independent lab work with digital logic devices or components and circuit assemblies
• Ability to apply engineering principals to the development of software for special test equipment
• Ability to work with cross functional teams following established BAE Systems design processes
• Strong communications skills and ability to work independentlyPreferred Education, Experience, & Skills • Scripting and programming language familiarity: Visual Studio, Python, C#, LabWindows/CVI, Assembly
• Familiarity with embedded engineering applications
• Knowledge of PowerPC architecture
• Familiarity with electrical engineering principles such as logic compatibility, timing and signal integrity

The 20-bed Nurse Residency Unit (NRU) serves 7 med/surg units by onboarding three cohorts of new graduate nurses each year. New graduate nurses complete the first part of their orientation on this dedicated unit with experienced preceptors, which provides new nurses with a solid clinical foundation prior to moving to their assigned home unit. The Nurse Residency Unit creates a safe learning environment to assist in developing competent, highly skilled nurses. Our dedicated preceptors, leadership team and Nurse Residency Coordinator provide unparalleled support to nurse residents during orientation and transition to practice.
